description: Code Engine job definitions (batch work that runs to completion). Identify a job with project_id and job_name. To run one, use ce_job_run with action submit. Call get_schema with name ce_job for every action's fields.

action.description: list: List job definitions. | get: Get one job definition. Needs job_name. | create: Create a job from a container image. Needs job_name, image. | update: Change image, scaling, array spec, or env. Needs job_name. | delete: Delete a job definition. Needs job_name.

env_vars.description: Environment variables as an object of name: value.

image_secret.description: Registry secret that can pull the image (a ce_secret with format registry).

job_name.description: Job definition name, from ce_job action list.

project_id.description: Project id or name, from ce_project action list.

name: ce_job
